title.narrative: Youth Skills for Recovery and Resilience in Gaza

description.narrative: A future skills learning Hub will be established within of one of UNESCO’s existing Temporary Learning Spaces (TLSs) in Gaza, providing youth and university students with access to practical skills development opportunities that support employability and resilience. Through short training courses, mentoring, and digital learning resources, participants will strengthen competencies in areas such as artificial intelligence, digital literacy, freelancing, entrepreneurship, and career readiness. Leveraging UNESCO’s existing infrastructure and the Gaza Virtual Campus, the initiative will offer a cost-effective and scalable approach to equip approximately 50 youth with future-oriented skills and pathways towards employment, self-employment, and continued learning.
